conditions: One-dimensional motion in an inertial frame with constant signed acceleration; initial state at elapsed time zero.
spoken_aliases: x equals x sub zero plus v sub zero times t plus one half times a times t squared
position equals initial position plus initial velocity times elapsed time plus one half times acceleration times elapsed time squared

evidence: Integrate dv/dt=a from zero to t to obtain v=v0+at. Integrate dx/dt=v over the same interval and apply x(0)=x0, giving the stated quadratic.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/3-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
